title: SpaceX acquires xAI in an all-stock deal

sources.quote: On February 2, 2026 (“xAI Merger Date”), the Company completed its acquisition of X.AI Holdings Corp.
The transaction values SpaceX at US$1 trillion, and xAI at US$250 billion, according to a person familiar with the matter.

explain: SpaceX bought xAI (which already owned X, formerly Twitter) by swapping xAI shares for SpaceX shares, so little cash changed hands. A source put xAI's value at about $250 billion. Both companies are controlled by Elon Musk.
